# mvdmio

> mvdmio builds five software products: Compliance, Translation Tools, Health Check, Statistics and Commonplace. Compliance leads and is a certification-ready management system for ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR and more. mvdmio is built and run by Michiel van der Meer.

## Products

- [Compliance](https://mvdm.io/products/compliance/): a certification-ready management system billed per framework (ISO 27001, SOC 2, ISO 9001 and eight more) from one set of records, with AI credit included.
- [Compliance for ISO 27001](https://mvdm.io/products/compliance/iso-27001/): running an ISO 27001 information security management system in Compliance, with registers, a 5×5 risk matrix, Annex A controls, audits and findings.
- [Translation Tools](https://mvdm.io/products/translation-tools/): keeps `.resx` files as the source of truth, fills empty locales with AI, and ships a NuGet client and a `translations` CLI for .NET projects.
- [Health Check](https://mvdm.io/products/health-check/): monitors uptime, DNS and SSL certificates, and crawls your app with automated smoke tests.
- [Statistics](https://mvdm.io/products/statistics/): tracks active users, throughput and response times across your applications from raw request data, self-hosted, with a drop-in .NET client.
- [Commonplace](https://mvdm.io/products/commonplace/): a personal place for books, quotes, notes, contacts and reminders, on an annual licence.

## Company

- [About](https://mvdm.io/about/): Michiel van der Meer, the software engineer and architect who builds and runs mvdmio, with two decades in industrial automation.
- [Open source](https://mvdm.io/open-source/): the MIT-licensed .NET packages mvdmio maintains on GitHub.
- [Legal](https://mvdm.io/legal/): Terms of Service, Privacy Notice, Data Processing Agreement, Subprocessor list and Company details, each as a PDF and all five as one pack.
